instructions: Finalize the exact existing clean failed candidate without modifying repository files.
Do not re-implement TASK-142, do not alter the committed candidate, and do not create helper or scratch files.
The previous native Antigravity failure was a provider/API network transport failure after the candidate commit; preserve the exact candidate HEAD.
Produce the required structural terminal ResultPackage for the existing candidate and allow Runtime to perform all canonical TASK-142 verification.
Bind the ResultPackage to the actual final HEAD and satisfy the original TASK-142 acceptance claims structurally without inventing external evidence.

acceptance.condition: Explicit content-addressed correction integration validates exact remote main and exact unique cumulative RESULT tip before materialization and is idempotent/fail-closed.
Conflict-free integration produces one exact two-parent merge candidate/ref without mutating persistent main/worktree; conflicts or ambiguous evidence create no authoritative ref.
Remote publication/readiness is fail closed: push failure or missing/moved remote integration ref cannot make integration success, Unified State readiness, or remediation execution possible.
Integrated execution-base grammar preserves semantic predecessor/cumulative tip separately, sets remediation Run.base_sha to the integration candidate, and remains backward-compatible.
Unified State, Correction Preflight, execution, and publication consume and independently validate the same exact integrated base; stale main/tip returns INTEGRATION_REQUIRED again.
TASK-141 repaired-PRIMARY semantic-root behavior remains intact and composes with integration.

TASK-140-shaped regression transitions deterministically from INTEGRATION_REQUIRED to remediation-ready only after explicit valid integration, with no Executor invoked by the integration operation itself.
Integrated remediation scope/changed-files accounting starts at the integration candidate and does not report current-main-only content as Executor mutation.
Publisher independently rejects forged/moved/stale integration evidence and accepts only exact remotely provable integrated lineage; existing non-integrated flows remain compatible.
Focused integration/operator/preflight/state/publication verification passes, git diff --check passes, RESULT has zero unresolved items, and production changes stay within authorized scope.

assumptions: TASK-141 is published and its repaired-PRIMARY semantic-root behavior is authoritative.

Historical RUN-135-004 candidate d4c822d64e43713995134d89c5b663f7d2a3390f passed its four Runtime verification commands and may be inspected as implementation reference, but must not be merged/cherry-picked blindly or treated as canonical state.
Integration is explicit Human-authorized deterministic Git plumbing, not coding-model conflict resolution and not a semantic lifecycle family.

hard: Preserve TASK-141 behavior exactly: operational root and semantic PRIMARY review root remain distinct. Integration support must compose with a successful REPAIR RESULT that is the semantic PRIMARY root after failed operational ancestors.

Expose an explicit operator surface compatible with the proven design: "aios integrate-correction" (aliases may remain) requiring exact task id/revision, cumulative-tip RUN id, cumulative-tip candidate SHA, and authorized current-main SHA.
Derive a deterministic content-addressed integration identity from that exact binding. Exact replay is idempotent; any changed/stale binding fails closed.

Before materialization, canonical remote lifecycle resolution is mandatory evidence. Require lifecycle.main_sha to equal authorized main and require exactly one valid RESULT operational tip whose RUN id and candidate SHA exactly match the authorized cumulative tip. Remote query/decode/missing-tip/competing-tip/mismatch failures must fail closed. Never substitute local refs/heads/main or locally present objects for canonical remote truth.

Version 1 supports conflict-free integration only. Compute/prove the exact clean merge tree for cumulative tip + authorized main. Any conflict, ambiguous/missing merge base, missing object, malformed state, or inability to prove the tree fails before an integration ref becomes authoritative.

Successful integration candidate must be a merge commit with exact parents [cumulative_tip_candidate_sha, authorized_main_sha] in that order and exact deterministic clean merge tree. Persistent worktree/branch/HEAD/main must remain unchanged.

Publish only a dedicated refs/heads/aios/integration/<integration_id> ref. Push must be checked. Success/readiness requires proving the exact canonical remote integration ref exists at the intended candidate SHA. Push/network/auth/non-fast-forward failure must fail closed; a local-only ref must never make Unified State or Preflight remediation-ready.
resolve_valid_integration in remote mode must require and validate the exact remote ref, exact parents, exact merge tree, exact cumulative tip and exact authorized main.

Extend prospective REMEDIATION execution-base grammar backward-compatibly with an integrated form binding at least integration identity, cumulative tip RUN/SHA, authorized main SHA, and integration candidate SHA. Run.base_sha must equal the integration candidate, while semantic predecessor remains unchanged.

Correction Preflight, Unified State, actual remediation execution, and Publisher must agree on the same integrated execution base. Before a valid exact integration exists, state remains INTEGRATION_REQUIRED. After it exists, the selected outstanding finding becomes execution-ready from the integrated base. Any later main/tip movement invalidates it.
Integrated remediation changed-files/scope accounting must use the integration candidate as execution baseline so current-main-only content is not misclassified as Executor mutation.
Publication must independently re-prove remote integration ref, parents, clean tree, cumulative RUN/RESULT, authorized main, execution-base binding, and final candidate ancestry before publication.
Existing non-integrated remediation semantics remain compatible. No historical backfill. Integration does not alter correction-frontier meaning.

Preserve TASK-135 reviewed fixes: no broad exception swallowing around canonical lifecycle resolution; no zero/multiple-tip acceptance; no local-main authority fallback; no ignored push failure; no local-ref preference that can bypass missing remote integration evidence.
Reconcile rather than overwrite current unified_state.py. TASK-141 semantic-root changes must remain present and receive integration-aware regression coverage.

Deterministic tests must include a TASK-140-shaped topology: repaired PRIMARY RESULT as semantic root, current main advanced after that RESULT, exact FINDING selector authorized, state/preflight initially INTEGRATION_REQUIRED, explicit clean integration materialized, then state/preflight READY/EXECUTE_REMEDIATION from the exact integrated base.
Do not push or publish from coding Executor implementation execution except the integration primitive itself when invoked by its dedicated tests/operator semantics.

task.goal: Bootstrap the previously proven correction-integration primitive onto current canonical main so an explicitly authorized, conflict-free integration candidate can bridge a divergent cumulative correction tip with current main and unblock TASK-140 remediation without rewriting historical RUN/REVIEW/REMEDIATION truth.
non_goals: Modify TASK-140 guard/adapter/hooks or execute FINDING-140-005/FINDING-140-006.
Rewrite TASK-135, TASK-140, or TASK-141 historical artifacts.
Automatically integrate whenever INTEGRATION_REQUIRED is observed.
Resolve merge conflicts or invoke an Executor to decide conflict resolution.
Move/reset/rebase/force-update main as part of integration.
Add a generic merge service, planner, queue, router, retry, fallback, or new lifecycle family.
Treat an integration candidate as RESULT, REVIEW, REMEDIATION, REPAIR, or publication truth.
